hook: My friends are hiding under it!
episode.ask: Can you help me find them?

finds.action_line: The cow can dance! Can you dance too?

gag_lines: Hmm? Who is hiding in there?
Is it a duck? Quack quack!
finds.action_line: The cat can spin! Can you spin too?
The horse can stomp! Can you stomp too?
The rooster can flap! Can you flap too?
The frog can wiggle! Can you wiggle too?
The sheep can dance! Can you dance too?
The bird can hop! Can you hop too?

lines: Let's hop, jump and stomp the ground,
Wave up high and wiggle low,
Flap your arms and dance with me,
Stretch up tall, wild and free,
Stomp your feet and spin around now,

finale: Thank you for finding all my friends!
Wow! A big rainbow, just for us!
Thank you, friends! I love you!
episode.shout: Surprise! We found everyone, Dino! Rainbow dance time!
episode.teaser_line: Next time, a new friend comes to play!
